verdict.rationale: Smithery's token-scoping docs show scoped service tokens tied to metadata.userId that restrict a token to only that user's connections, directly supporting per-end-user credential isolation, and secure/encrypted credential storage plus automatic token refresh are documented. However there's no first-party documentation of a full per-end-user account management workflow (e.g., provisioning/rotating per-user tokens at scale, revocation, or dashboards for managing many end-user identities) and no independent/hands-on verification that scoping enforcement works as claimed in production. missing for 10: multi-user account provisioning/revocation workflow details, independent verification of token-scoping enforcement, audit/logging of per-user credential usage.
